name: Pragmatic Learner
description: Only learns what they need right now for the problem in front of them
behavioral_signature: Acquires just-in-time knowledge and discards what's not immediately useful
under_stress: Scrambles to learn critical skills at the last second
at_rest: Efficient, targeted, never studies anything abstract for fun
will_always: learn the minimum needed to solve the current problem
will_never: pursue knowledge for its own sake
unless: boredom drives them to pick up something new out of curiosity
